name: Python Bot (Optimized)
author: manish@arixbyte.com
description: A custom Python Egg optimized for discord.py bots. Supports GitHub auto-updating, requirements.txt auto-installation, and unbuffered logging.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [ -f /mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} ]; then pip install -U --prefix .local -r ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}; fi; if [[ ! -z "${PY_PACKAGES}" ]]; then pip install -U --prefix .local ${PY_PACKAGES}; fi; /usr/local/bin/python -u /mnt/server/${STARTUP_FILE}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y git python3 python3-pip
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
  echo -e "User upload set to true, skipping GitHub clone."
  exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  echo -e "No GIT_ADDRESS provided, skipping clone."
  exit 0
fi

echo -e "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .

if [ ! -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
  echo -e "Checking out branch ${BRANCH}..."
  git checkout ${BRANCH}
fi

echo -e "Installation Complete!"
